title: Palladium-103 brachytherapy with continuous periodic intravitreal Anti-VEGF bevacizumab for ciliary body medulloepithelioma

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:

【Purpose · abstract-1-1】To report a case of medulloepithelioma treated with palladium-103 (103Pd) plaque brachytherapy, followed by adjunctive continuous periodic intravitreal anti-vascular endothelial growth factor (anti-VEGF) therapy, highlighting a novel combined strategy for tumor control and management of its neovascular complications.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Palladium-103 brachytherapy with continuous periodic intravitreal Anti-VEGF bevacizumab for ciliary body medulloepithelioma》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Conclusions and importance · abstract-3-1】103Pd plaque brachytherapy was used to control a ciliary body medulloepithelioma. However, iridotomies and continuous periodic anti-VEGF therapy were needed to suppress tumor-related secondary neovascular glaucoma. This approach achieved durable local tumor control while preserving the globe and functional vision. Targeted radiation and pharmacologic neovascular suppression offered a novel globe and vision-sparing treatment for medulloepithelioma.
